title: How to Build an AI Chatbot for Your Website
summary: Build a custom AI chatbot that's trained on your data, tracks conversations, and costs a fraction of Intercom. Full step-by-step guide for 2026.
body_markdown: Go to[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and describe what you need: "Build a support chatbot with a knowledge base, conversation history stored in a database, and an admin panel to view all conversations." Blink generates the full-stack app — React chat widget, backend API, Postgres database for conversation logs, and admin dashboard. No config needed. Database and auth are included automatically. Choose from 200+ AI models to power the responses.
